source_name: FinTech Futures — Czechia region page
source_subtype: trade press with country archive + PR channel
why_relevant: Country-filtered feed of CZ fintech/banking-tech news plus a press-release channel used directly by vendors (e.g. Temenos/Komercni banka Transact win). Country page acts as a pointer and a low-cost monitoring endpoint.

source_name: bne IntelliNews (Emerging Europe / CEE business wire)
why_relevant: Investor-facing English coverage of the 30 emerging-Europe markets including Czechia, with recurring banking/payments market items (contactless leadership, bank M&A, fintech scene). Fills the gap where CZ trade press is not translated and where CEE-wide comparatives are needed.

source_name: KBC Group newsroom (English) — parent of ČSOB
why_relevant: ČSOB is wholly owned by KBC; group newsroom and quarterly reports announce CZ-relevant acquisitions (e.g. Business Lease CZ/SK) and technology/partner moves in English before or instead of Czech releases.

source_name: Raiffeisen Bank International — media hub / press releases
why_relevant: Parent group of Raiffeisenbank a.s. (CZ). English group releases and quarterly reports cover CZ subsidiary strategy, digital lending platforms and technology partners; complements CZ-only local PR.

source_name: GlobeNewswire (vendor press-release wire)
why_relevant: Where US/EU banking-software vendors issue CZ win announcements verbatim and dated — e.g. nCino announcing ČSOB selecting its platform for commercial/SME lending (Mar 2025). Primary-source text of the deal, usually richer than the trade-press rewrite.

source_name: Business Wire (incl. Czech-language newsroom feed)
why_relevant: Second major wire used by payments vendors and acquirers (Global Payments, CaixaBank) for CZ/CEE deal announcements; also operates a Czech-language release feed, giving a bilingual capture point for the same deals.

source_name: American Banker / PaymentsSource
why_relevant: US payments trade title that periodically covers CZ firsts and technology launches (e.g. ČSOB's HCE NFC wallet launch), giving international framing and vendor identification for Czech deployments.

source_name: Retail Banker International / Electronic Payments International (GlobalData titles)
why_relevant: GlobalData-owned trade titles that carry CZ vendor wins (Komerční banka–Temenos) and CEE structural deals (Erste/Global Payments JV) and link through to GlobalData market-sizing, bridging news and analyst data.

source_name: Temenos press releases & success stories (vendor-side primary)
why_relevant: Illustrates the vendor-newsroom pattern that defines this cell: the KB Transact selection, go-live and success story (with implementation partner Syncordis named) are documented on the vendor site in English long before Czech media detail them. Same pattern applies to nCino, FICO, IDEMIA, Finshape, Antelop.

source_name: nCino newsroom (via wire) — ČSOB commercial/SME lending win
why_relevant: Concrete recent (Mar 2025) example of a top-3 Czech bank's platform selection disclosed only through an English vendor release; a must-watch vendor for CZ lending-platform competition and a template for the vendor-watchlist method.

source_name: Celent — research and Model Bank awards
why_relevant: Analyst house whose Model Bank awards named MONETA Money Bank (CZ) for a card-modernisation initiative — award write-ups routinely disclose the technology and vendor behind a Czech bank's programme. Also publishes European payments and retail-banking IT spend forecasts usable as market baselines.

source_name: Gartner Magic Quadrant / Forrester Wave coverage of banking & payment-hub platforms (incl. secondary pickup)
why_relevant: Vendor placement in the Gartner MQ for Banking Payment Hub Platforms and Forrester digital-banking landscapes is the standard competitive frame vendors use in CZ tenders; press pickup of placements is free and gives the vendor field even without a licence.

source_name: GlobalData company profiles (Czech banks)
why_relevant: Aggregated English profiles of CZ banks with deal history, technology initiatives and competitor sets — an aggregator view that no Czech source assembles; also the data layer behind Retail Banker International reporting.

source_name: Euromoney — CEE banking coverage and country Awards for Excellence
why_relevant: Annual country awards (e.g. Czech Republic's best bank for large corporates 2025 — Raiffeisenbank) plus CEE bank/fintech features give an independent English read on competitive positioning and digital initiatives among CZ banks.

source_name: The Digital Banker (awards + case-study write-ups)
why_relevant: Award-driven English write-ups describing CZ bank programmes in implementation detail — e.g. Raiffeisenbank's new retail lending platform in the Czech Republic — often naming the platform and delivery partner. Award submissions surface projects banks do not otherwise publicise.

source_name: Chambers Global Practice Guides — Fintech: Czech Republic
why_relevant: Annually refreshed English legal-market overview of the CZ fintech/payments landscape written by local counsel — reliable for regulator names, licence categories, market structure and actor mapping that feed better queries elsewhere.

source_name: ffnews (Financial IT / Fintech Finance News)
why_relevant: High-volume English fintech PR aggregator that republishes vendor releases and runs country features (e.g. real-time payments in the Czech Republic); useful as a broad net that catches releases the bigger titles skip.

source_name: Expats.cz (English-language Czech domestic outlet)
why_relevant: Seznam-independent, Prague-based English news covering Czech retail banking changes for a foreign audience; bridges local-market developments into English and often flags consumer-facing payment/product launches earlier than international trade press.

source_name: Finshape (CZ/CEE digital-banking vendor) customer stories
why_relevant: Regional (originally Czech) digital-banking vendor publishing named CZ bank customer stories (e.g. Raiffeisenbank); a local-language counterpart to the international vendor-newsroom pattern and a pointer to which CZ banks run which front-end stack.

source_name: CMS Law CEE deal announcements (Prague office)
why_relevant: Advisory law firms publish English deal notices naming parties and structures for CZ/CEE banking-payments transactions (e.g. advising Erste Group on the CEE JV with Global Payments and CaixaBank) — an independent confirmation channel and a pointer to deals before or beyond press coverage.
